_description: Held-out generalization test set. Unlike backend/data/labeled_incidents.json, none of these cases use the 'KEY VALUE' convention (e.g. 'AUTH FAILED user=... src=...') that every labeled_incidents.json fixture shares with the _BENIGN_MARKERS / signature keyword lists in backend/app/agents/detection_agent.py - that overlap made the existing 1.0/1.0/1.0/1.0 eval score close to self-grading. These cases cover the same attack categories in log formats/wording a real environment would actually produce: Windows Security Event text, Sysmon-style process/file events, CEF with non-standard field ordering, a generic email security gateway, a real Zeek/Bro conn.log line, and native JSON Kubernetes audit log entries. Two cases are deliberately ambiguous-benign phrased in unfamiliar wording, to test whether the false-positive suppression generalizes or only recognizes its exact hardcoded markers.
